Hey! I'm Roba Copilot — your co-pilot for the Unitree G1. Here's what we can do together:

🤖 Poses  
"Make the robot wave its right hand."  
"Show the robot bowing slightly."  
"Put the robot in a balanced T‑pose."

✋ Hands  
"Close the left hand into a fist."  
"Open the right hand flat."  
"Make both hands gesture a thumbs‑up."

🎬 Simulation  
"Run a walking cycle across the room."  
"Simulate the robot picking up a small box."  
"Create a smooth turning motion while the robot talks."

⌨️ Code & Controls  
"Add keyboard shortcuts to toggle the robot’s waist twist."  
"Implement a simple controller for arm waving."  
"Expose a UI slider to adjust the robot’s walking speed."
